summary: @or-sdk/idw preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a TypeScript REST SDK for an IDW API but declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, which on `npm install` downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})` to run `math_init.js`, a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped in the tarball. The payload uses a string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}`), a shuffled numeric constant table, and a custom-alphabet base decoder; all URL/host constants and imports are hidden behind the decoder. Fetching a second language runtime to execute an opaque bundled script has no legitimate role in a REST client SDK, and the alternate-runtime path routes execution outside Node's normal analysis surface. The bundled code runs automatically on default install, before the installer has any opportunity to inspect it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
